title: FindDefaultImageRequest
description: The request object to filter data that is used for retrieving an image from the default image catalog.

provider.description: Cloud provider - either AWS, AZURE or GCP

architecture.description: Specifies the CPU architecture. Values are ARM64, X86_64. Default is X86_64.

VmImageProvider.description:
Object representing a valid cloud provider name.
 `AWS` - The image is an AWS VM image `AZURE` - The image is an Azure VM image `GCP` - The image is a GCP VM image

VmImageType.description:
Object representing a valid VM image type.
 `FREEIPA` - FreeIPA image `RUNTIME` - Cloudera Runtime image
